# Golden encoded envelopes of the pipeline leaf. One line per document:
#   label key type-id schema-name payload-hex   (payload is the cultcache MessagePack payload)
# Provenance: the payload lines were dumped once by `golden_dump` from this
# crate at huginn 44be4cd. 87b6455 differs from 44be4cd only in test code
# (cfg(test) items; no encoding path). They match the encoder of Epiphany
# ef956865 byte for byte after one substitution: the sample source-path string
# was renamed in four kinds (cut_spec, cut_report, finding, follow_up), where it
# sits in a CodeLocation path. Soul proved the encoding byte-identical to the
# live mind store (eureka-body:verdict:cut-leaf-into-huginn.s1) and to
# Epiphany ef956865 modulo that rename (verdict ...s2). Never regenerate to make
# a failing test pass: a diff here is a wire change and needs its own ruling.
